methodology: Deep-read of ultimate_pipeline/main_pipeline.py, pipeline_stages/*, contracts/*, geometry/*, quality/* by a dedicated research agent, cross-checked against actual code (not filenames/assumptions). Real stage-calling order verified from main_pipeline.py:2036-2380.

stages.note: Repairs dangling junction-link references; does not touch lanes/elevation.

stages.changes_planview: only if ENABLE_ROUNDABOUT_RECONSTRUCTION is set (off by default in every named release profile)
stages.note: Explicitly geometry-only/no-lanes-yet by contract: semantic_state['has_lanes']=False set here. ARCHITECTURAL SMELL (not proven to cause defects): buildings/signals/crosswalks run here, BEFORE lanes exist (stage 7) and BEFORE the geometry freeze (stage 5) -- no code dependency found requiring this order, appears to be a historical/monolithic-file artifact rather than a real requirement.

Orchestrates: calls stage 6's _step6_planview_continuity FIRST, then freezes XY (geometryFrozen/geometryFreezeHash header attrs + sha256), then applies DEM elevation, then applies PlanViewSmoother.clamp_curvature UNCONDITIONALLY (not gated by any 'unsafe' flag -- this makes the stage-6 gated curvature-clamp flag partially redundant with this ungated path).

reads: topo_fixed (passed as elev_out param from stage 5)
stages.note: GOVERNED CONTAINMENT MODE: under any non-DEVELOPMENT profile or THESIS_STRICT, this stage is entirely READ-ONLY/diagnostic -- copies input to output byte-identically for protected tags (planView, elevationProfile, lateralProfile, lanes, signals, objects, LaneLinks, junctions, road.length) and raises BLOCKED_STAGE_ORDER_VIOLATION if a semantic diff is detected. This is a hard architectural fail-safe, not merely unsafe flags defaulting off. See root_cause_analysis below.
Fails hard if 0 driving lanes. Always exactly 1 driving lane per side (see MAP_QUALITY_GAP_REGISTER GAP-001).

987 lines, most entangled stage: many sequential intermediate files and conditional branches based on env flags. This is the 'authoritative map switch' point -- final_out becomes canonical after laneSection repair.
Explicitly ordered islands->lanes->z-seams->widths because island removal changes what 'fewest references' means for later repairs. Island quarantine capped at 25% of total roads as a safety valve.
Operates on final_out's already-frozen geometry; does not re-touch planView. Includes post-tiling S-invariant scan/fix for negative s/sOffset (a CARLA-crash class of bug).
CARLA-subprocess-isolated. Fully skips if CARLA unreachable/disabled -- most affected by the CARLA-runtime blocker documented elsewhere in this repo's memory.
Interactive-only (UP_INTERACTIVE=1 + ENABLE_SIMULATION_GATE). Effectively dead in automated/CI runs.
Read-only w.r.t. the XODR itself. No-op if MANUAL_MAP_XODR not configured.

load_bearing_invariant.name: geometry_freeze_hash
load_bearing_invariant.description: stage 5's geometryFrozen/geometryFreezeHash header attributes + sha256, asserted by stage 7 (_assert_geometry_frozen) and stage 8 (same assertion) at entry. The entire lane/lane-link machinery assumes planView is immutable once frozen.
load_bearing_invariant.risk_if_violated: Any code path that mutates planView after stage 5's freeze point without updating the hash would silently desync lanes/lane-links from their geometric basis with no detection.

stage6_containment_root_cause_analysis.question: Is the topology -> enrichment -> geometry -> lanes ordering fundamentally responsible for the Stage-6 containment problem?
stage6_containment_root_cause_analysis.verdict: NO -- reordering pipeline stages would not fix this. The unsafe mutators are internally incomplete/buggy at the function level, not victims of stage sequencing.

per_flag_findings.detail: PlanViewSmoother.smooth_heading_jumps (geometry/planview_smoother.py:147-234) mutates only a geometry's hdg attribute without touching that geometry's or downstream geometries' x/y. Since OpenDRIVE <geometry> elements each declare absolute x/y/hdg independently, this silently displaces every downstream endpoint unless a re-chaining step follows in the same call. Guards were added since the last dated report to skip the last/terminal-anchor geometries, but the core defect (hdg-only mutation with no companion recompute) is unchanged.

per_flag_findings.assessment: mandatory companion fix, itself has a narrower, now-partially-patched defect
per_flag_findings.detail: recompute_geometry_starts_chained_inplace (quality/check_geometric_continuity.py:490-553) mishandles paramPoly3 geometries whose declared length doesn't match true parametric arc length when pRange='arcLength'. Commit 21cc6430 (2026-09-04, after the prior C33 report) added a guard skipping re-chaining across such a boundary rather than trusting the wrong endpoint. UNVERIFIED: no follow-up end-to-end rerun of the full heading-smoothing scenario against this guard was found (no C34/C35 report exists).

Both have explicit spatial-gap anchor guards (planview_smoother.py:298-321, 397-412) with comments describing a prior regression ('100s-1000s m link gaps') that the guard now prevents. No companion report documents a clean rerun with the guard in place, so they remain gated out of caution.

per_flag_findings.assessment: low-risk, and partially redundant with an already-live ungated path
per_flag_findings.detail: clamp_curvature only rewrites <arc curvature>, cannot desync a chain the way heading/merge operations can. stage_05_geometry.py:1037 already applies PlanViewSmoother.clamp_curvature UNCONDITIONALLY elsewhere in production -- this stage-6 gated flag is largely redundant.

confirmed_improvements_over_live_order: Moving buildings/signals/crosswalks to run AFTER lane/cross-section and structural freeze (proposal) vs. their current position in stage 4 before lanes exist and before freeze (live) better matches the semantic_state contract's own implication that these don't need to precede lane generation. No code dependency found in stage 4 requiring lane generation to happen after it.

Promoting 'structural freeze' to an explicit named stage: this mechanism already exists (geometryFrozen/geometryFreezeHash + _assert_geometry_frozen) but is buried inside stage 5's function body. Making it a first-class stage with its own gate/report is a real, low-risk architectural win.
discrepancies_vs_live_order: Proposal orders 'junction/connector geometry' before 'roundabout structural reconstruction', but live order has roundabout reconstruction in stage 4 (before geometry/planView normalization in stage 5/6), and junction-connector rebuild is an opt-in POST-planView-smoothing step inside stage 5 (disabled by default). Whether RoundaboutReconstructor structurally requires pre- or post-normalization geometry was not independently verified against ultimate_pipeline/topology/roundabout_reconstructor.py's own assumptions.
proposed_target_ordering_assessment.not_independently_assessed: Earliest proposed stages ('pinned input ingest', 'base OSM->XODR conversion') precede ultimate_pipeline's own stage numbering entirely and were out of scope for this pass.

global_injection_pattern.mechanism: _inject_main_pipeline_globals() helper present at the top of all 13 pipeline_stages/*.py files, copies the ENTIRE main_pipeline module namespace into each stage module's own globals at call time. Stage functions reference these as bare names with no explicit import.
global_injection_pattern.example: stage_06_links.py:408 calls load_xodr(elev_out) with no import; only resolves via injection.
global_injection_pattern.self_reference_pattern: Every stage function takes `self` (the live MainPipeline instance) and freely reads/writes its attributes directly (self.settings, self.out_dir, self.vreport, self.qgate used 9-55x per file; self.semantic_state is an untyped plain dict mutated in place by stages 4/5/6/7 as an ad-hoc state machine with no type enforcement).

existing_typed_abstractions.StageContext_or_StageResult_protocol: CONFIRMED ABSENT in ultimate_pipeline/contracts/ (checked all 9 files). Closest analog is contracts/gate_runner.py's CumulativeGateRunner/GateRunRecord -- a real, clean, dataclass-based abstraction, but scoped only to quality-gate bookkeeping, not stage I/O. This proves isolated typed contracts CAN coexist with the current architecture.

software_architecture_a13.migration_feasibility: plausible as an incremental, stage-by-stage migration, but genuinely large/risky given the implicit-import pattern (would need to make dependencies explicit before a typed context could help). self.semantic_state is the best first migration candidate (small, flat, already well-scoped). Stage 8 (987 lines, most entangled) and stages 5/6 (containment-mechanism-critical) should be migrated LAST, after the pattern is proven safe on low-stakes stages (1, 11, or 12).
software_architecture_a13.migration_template_available: stage 6's own _semantic_stage6_diff / geometry-freeze-hash machinery is a working template for how golden-equivalence tests could be written for other stages during migration.
